links.outcome: Endoscopist diagnostic accuracy with versus without AI assistance, by experience level
links.effect: Junior endoscopists improved accuracy from 0.866 to 0.951 after AADM assistance (P < 0.01); AADM alone 0.938 vs junior 0.866 (P<0.05), comparable to senior 0.937.
links.quote: Additionally, junior endoscopists significantly improved their accuracy from 0.866 to 0.951 after receiving assistance from the AADM (P < 0.01).

links.outcome: AI model diagnostic accuracy compared with endoscopists of varying experience on same images
links.effect: AADM accuracy 0.938 was superior to junior endoscopists (0.866, P<0.05) and comparable to senior endoscopists (0.937, P>0.05).
links.quote: The diagnostic performance of the AADM was superior to that of junior endoscopists (accuracy: 0.938 vs. 0.866, P < 0.05) and comparable to senior endoscopists (accuracy: 0.938 vs. 0.937, P > 0.05).

screen.reason: The study evaluated an AI-assisted diagnostic model (DeepLabV3+) on magnifying colonoscopy images and tested the practice of AI assistance by comparing junior endoscopist diagnostic accuracy with and without the tool's assistance.
